tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background, panels, dialogs, book cards, answer messages, PDF pages.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Thumbnail sidebar, the grey surround behind PDF pages, the chat input, card cover area, hover fill for secondary and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, panel edges, progress-bar track. Decorative only (1.24:1 on bg): never the only edge of a control — inputs use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, secondary buttons, steppers and the drop zone: 3.3:1 on bg, 3.08:1 on bg-subtle. Intentional addition: the brief's border is too faint for a control edge.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and UI text on bg (15.9:1), bg-subtle (14.8:1), accent-soft (14.4:1). Also the label on orange fills (see on-accent).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — author names, page counts, percentages, empty-state lines — on bg (4.83:1) and bg-subtle (4.52:1). Not on accent-soft (4.41:1).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only (exempt from contrast minimums). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, as a FILL: primary buttons, progress-bar fill, send button. Small areas only — never a panel, header or large block. Not for text or thin strokes on white (2.7:1): use accent-text or accent-line.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons and the send button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected items (active menu row, chat toggle on), the user's question bubble, the Preparing badge, the drop zone while a file is dragged over.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange as TEXT or icon: links (Retry, Change file, Try again), active page number, active toolbar icon. 4.94:1 on bg, 4.51:1 on accent-soft. Intentional addition: accent itself is 2.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Orange as a STROKE: the 2px focus ring, the active thumbnail outline, the dragged-over drop-zone edge. 3.26:1 on bg, 3.04:1 on bg-subtle.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on accent and accent-hover fills: 5.84:1 / 4.85:1. White on accent is 2.7:1 and fails, so primary buttons carry dark ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The Ready dot and check icon (3.3:1 on bg). Not for text — use success-strong.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Ready badge.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the Ready badge, on success-soft (4.57:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger button fill (white label 4.83:1), Delete menu item text and inline error text on bg (4.83:1), error edge of inputs and the drop zone.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Danger button hover fill; text and icon of the Failed badge on danger-soft (5.3:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Failed badge.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger and danger-strong fills (4.83:1 / 6.47:1).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs (Add book, Delete, Re-index).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Library header title and Add book dialog title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Confirmation dialog titles, the app name in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This removes the book and its data.
styles.usage: The UI base: dialog copy, menu items, inputs, empty states.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, links, the reader's book title.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Book card title, clamped to two lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Author, reading progress, percentages, status bar, help and error text.

styles.name: chat
styles.sample: The ELBO is a lower bound on the log-evidence.
styles.usage: Questions, answers and the chat input text.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: Developer annotations naming the action a control calls. Design files only; never shipped in the product.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges, dot spacing in the thinking indicator.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, toolbar items, icon and label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card body padding, input side padding, thumbnail gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Chat message gap, panel padding, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, library grid gap, gap between PDF pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Library page margins, drop-zone padding, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, inputs, dialogs, menus, the chat bubble and composer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows, annotation chips, thumbnails' focus outline. Intentional addition.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and the progress bar. Intentional addition.

shadow.note: Borders do the separating; shadows are reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: PDF pages on the bg-subtle surround and page thumbnails.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Card ⋯ menu, sort menu, book card hover.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the overlay scrim.

layout.note: Fixed regions of the desktop layout (1440×900 first, works at 1280×800).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Library header.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Reader top bar.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: Reader status bar (page X / Y).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Thumbnail sidebar, collapsible to 0.

tokens.name: chat-panel-width
tokens.usage: Chat panel default width.

tokens.name: chat-panel-min
tokens.usage: Smallest width the chat panel can be dragged to.

tokens.name: chat-panel-max
tokens.usage: Largest width the chat panel can be dragged to.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Book card width; the library grid auto-fills columns of this width with space-6 gaps.
